fishing: WHEN: Mon Oct 26 NE winds easing, fish protected waters early. PASSES-BEACH: redfish near passes on live shrimp/pilchards or gold spoons; pompano in surf. LEMON BAY: redfish, snook, trout around docks/mangroves/oyster bars; mangrove snapper at piers. NEARSHORE: Spanish mackerel 1-2 mi off on reefs; limited offshore. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, gold spoons. Sources: FL Sportsman SW (Capt. Stamper redfish top vote), Fishin Franks / Capt. Mike reports.
redtide: FWC Oct 23: K. brevis at background offshore Lee County. Bloom concentrations first this season in 2 samples NW FL St. Joseph Bay (Gulf Co). No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 30.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD ~10 CFU/100mL (DOH Charlotte Healthy Beaches). No advisory. Manasota Key / Palm Island similar good.
fpl: Charlotte ~1-14, Sarasota ~1-28 outages (minor/isolated per recent trackers); small only, no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
